purpose: Check claim fidelity separately from whether an adopted strategy passes Gatecheck's Sharpe gate

reddit.note: Current body removed by moderators; author-linked site unavailable. Stored July paraphrases are secondary recovery evidence.

paper_sign.note: Source uses dividend-adjusted prices, log returns and sign-continuation inference, not a Sharpe rejection as a calibration certificate.

paper_sma.note: Publisher full text inaccessible; paper title metadata found. Exact timing, fees and dates remain unverified.

detrick.note: Reported S&P 500 historical forward-direction statement; original event table/separation rule not located.

quarter.note: Two successive calendar quarters must each gain; cumulative six-month gain is a different outcome. Underlying NYT event table is not supplied.

month.note: Calendar-month S&P 500 event study. Displayed table starts October 1974 although prose says past 50 years.

qqq225.note: Return and drawdown claims over January 2000-February 2025; precise trade fills, fees, price adjustment and start/end sessions are unstated.

rsi2.note: Owner's public alternate specifies RSI2 crossings below 10 and above 80. Exact price treatment, fill timing and sample endpoint remain unspecified.

ranked_rally.note: Retrospectively ranked top 20 non-overlapping SPX rallies; every day above a fixed threshold is not that selection.

rsi5.note: RSI5 below 30, trend and confirmation, RSI50 exit. Trend slope duration, confirmation, execution, price basis and sample dates are incompletely specified.
